The '''reanimation serum''' was an invention of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] that could re-animate the bodies of dead [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. By injecting himself with a megadose of his own serum, Evazan was able to return to life, after being "killed" by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
